name: Wind The
overview: Scripture reveals that the wind is a powerful instrument of God's sovereign will, capable of both judgment and provision. In the Exodus narratives, the LORD commands east and west winds to bring locusts and then remove them, demonstrating His control over nature to fulfill His purposes. The wind also facilitates miraculous deliverance, as seen when a strong east wind parts the sea, and it brings sustenance by carrying quails to the Israelites in the wilderness. Furthermore, God’s wind can calm storms, as in the account of Jonah, highlighting His authority over creation to accomplish His redemptive plans.
